metaDescription: Order custom paper sticky notes & flags in bulk. Perfect for reminders, tabs, and promotions. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Paper sticky notes and flags remain a staple in offices and schools because they are easy to write on, reposition, and recycle. Unlike plastic alternatives, paper versions offer a natural texture that works well with pens, pencils, and highlighters. For bulk buyers, custom paper sticky notes and flags provide a cost-effective way to keep your brand top-of-mind during daily tasks. Choose from standard sizes like 3x3 or page-marking flags, and add your logo in one or two colors for a clean, professional look.
